Careers

We’re always on the lookout for talented and passionate individuals to join our growing team. Whether you’re an artist, programmer, or game designer, Casual Brothers is the perfect place to develop your career in the gaming industry.

Check out our current openings below if you think you’d be a great fit for Casual Brothers. We offer a dynamic, fun work environment and the chance to contribute to games played by people all around the world!

Unity/Unreal Developer

  • Description: We are looking for a Senior Unity/Unreal Developer with experience in video game development to join our high-performance team.

  • Requirements:
    • At least 3 years of experience working with Unity/Unreal in game development.
    • Experience in developing multi-platform games (PC, Consoles, Mobile).
    • Experience withs ports
    • Proficiency in C++ and deep knowledge of the game lifecycle in Unity.
    • Strong experience in performance optimization and code debugging.
    • Familiarity with agile workflows and tools.
    • Passion for the video game industry and creating interactive experiences.
    • Ability to work both independently and in a team, maintaining a high standard of quality.
Apply Now

3D Artists, Animators, Sound Designers & VFX Artists

  • Description: We are looking for talented individuals in the fields of 3D Art, Animation, Sound Design, and VFX to join our team. Depending on your expertise, your role will involve creating high-quality assets, animations, sound effects, or visual effects that enhance the gameplay experience. You will collaborate with the design and development teams to ensure that all artistic elements align with the game’s aesthetic and performance requirements.

  • Requirements:
    • At least 3 years of experience.
    • Experience working with Unity/Unreal
    • Collaborate with programmers, designers, and other artists to maintain consistency in the game’s visual and auditory style.
    • Familiarity with industry-standard tools such as Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, ZBrush, Houdini, FMOD, Wwise, or equivalent depending on your field.
Apply Now
